'.'))\n        .unwrap_or(rest.len());\n    rest[..end].split('.').next().unwrap().parse().unwrap()\n}\n\nfn json_f64(body: &str, key: &str) -> f64 {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{key}\\\":\");\n The reference oracle is a plain uncompressed `Vec<(i64, i64)>` built\n//! alongside the writes: every range response must equal the naive\n//! `retain` filter over that array.\n\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\n\nuse tsblock::server::{self, get, post, FaultMode};\nuse tsblock::coding::Point;\n\nfn tempdir(tag: &str) -> PathBuf {\n    let d = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(\n        \"tsblock-http-{tag}-{}-{}\",\n        std::process::id(),\n        std::time::SystemTime::now()\n            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n            .unwrap()\n            .as_nanos()\n    ));\n    std::fs::create_dir_all(&d).unwrap();\n    d\n}\n\n/// Deterministic xorshift64* so the dataset is reproducible.\nstruct Rng(u64);\nimpl Rng {\n    fn next(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        let mut x = self.0;\n        x ^= x >> 12;\n        x ^= x << 25;\n        x ^= x >> 27;\n        self.0 = x;\n        x.wrapping_mul(0x2545_F491_4F6C_DD1D)\n    }\n    fn range(&mut self, n: u64) -> i64 {\n        (self.next() % n) as i64\n    }\n}\n\nfn body_of(points: &[Point]) -> String {\n    points\n        .iter()\n        .map(|p| format!(\"{},{}\", p.ts, p.value))\n        .collect::<Vec<_>>()\n        .join(\"\\n\")\n}\n\n/// Parse `\"points\":[[i,i],[i,i]]` out of a response body.\nfn parse_points(body: &str) -> Vec<Point> {\n    let key = \"\\\"points\\\":[\";\n    let start = body.find(key).unwrap() + key.len();\n    let end = body[start..].find(']').unwrap() + start;\n    let inner = &body[start..end];\n    inner\n        .split(\"],[\")\n        .map(|pair| {\n            let cleaned: String = pair\n                .chars()\n                .filter(|c| c.is_ascii_digit() || *c == ',' || *c == '-')\n                .collect();\n            let (ts, v) = cleaned.split_once(',').unwrap();\n            Point::new(ts.parse().unwrap(), v.parse().unwrap())\n        })\n        .collect()\n}\n\nfn json_u64(body: &str, key: &str) -> u64 {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{key}\\\":\");\n    let i = body.find(&pat).unwrap() + pat.len();\n    let rest = &body[i..];\n    let end = rest\n        .find(|c: char| !(c.is_ascii_digit() || c == '-' || c == '.'))\n        .unwrap_or(rest.len());\n    rest[..end].split('.').next().unwrap().parse().unwrap()\n}\n\nfn json_f64(body: &str, key: &str) -> f64 {\n    let pat = format!(\"\\\"{key}\\\":\");\n    let i = body.find(&pat).unwrap() + pat.len();\n    let rest = &body[i..];\n    let end = rest\n        .find(|c: char| !(c.is_ascii_digit() || c == '-' || c == '.'))\n        .unwrap_or(rest.len());\n    rest[..end].parse().unwrap()\n}\n\nfn reference_filter(points: &[Point], start: i64, end: i64) -> Vec<Point> {\n    points\n        .iter()\n        .copied()\n        .filter(|p| p.ts >= start && p.ts <= end)\n        .collect()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn full_acceptance_over_http() {\n    let dir = tempdir(\"accept\");\n    let handle = server::serve(\n        \"127.0.0.1:0\",\n        dir,\n        100,\n        FaultMode::On, // enables /dev/fault\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    let addr = handle.addr();\n\n    // ---- build the reference dataset and write it ----------------------\n    let mut rng = Rng(0x1234_5678_9ABC_DEF0);\n    let n = 5000usize;\n    let mut reference = Vec::with_capacity(n);\n    let mut ts = 1_700_000_000i64;\n    let mut value = -50i64;\n    for i in 0..n {\n        let delta = if i % 997 == 0 && i > 0 {\n            0 // repeated timestamp every ~1000 points\n        } else {\n            58 + rng.range(7) // 58..=64: varied but non-decreasing\n        };\n        ts += delta;\n        value += rng.range(7) - 3; // random walk crossing zero often\n        reference.push(Point::new(ts, value));\n    }\n\n    let (st, body) = post(addr, \"/series/ref?policy=reject&block_size=100\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 201, \"{body}\");\n\n    // Write in several batches (none aligned to a block boundary).\n    for chunk in reference.chunks(333) {\n        let (st, body) = post(addr, \"/series/ref/points\", &body_of(chunk));\n        assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{body}\");\n    }\n    let (st, body) = post(addr, \"/series/ref/flush\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{body}\");\n    assert_eq!(json_u64(&body, \"blocks_flushed\"), 50); // 5000/100\n\n    // ---- range queries vs the uncompressed oracle ----------------------\n    let (st, body) = get(addr, &format!(\"/series/ref/range?start={}&end={}\", i64::MIN, i64::MAX));\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{body}\");\n    assert_eq!(json_u64(&body, \"count\"), n as u64);\n    assert_eq!(parse_points(&body), reference);\n\n    // Boundary cases: exact endpoints, single point, empty window, ranges\n    // spanning block boundaries, negatives in both dimensions.\n    let windows = [\n        (reference[0].ts, reference[0].ts),\n        (reference[n - 1].ts, reference[n - 1].ts),\n        (reference[1000].ts, reference[1234].ts),\n        (reference[0].ts - 1, reference[0].ts),\n        (reference[n - 1].ts, reference[n - 1].ts + 1),\n        (reference[42].ts + 1, reference[43].ts - 1), // empty (strictly between)\n        (-10_000_000_000, 10_000_000_000),\n        (i64::MIN, i64::MAX),\n    ];\n    for (start, end) in windows {\n        let (st, body) =\n            get(addr, &format!(\"/series/ref/range?start={start}&end={end}\"));\n        assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{body}\");\n        let got = parse_points(&body);\n        let want = reference_filter(&reference, start, end);\n        assert_eq!(got, want, \"window [{start},{end}]\");\n    }\n\n    // Duplicate timestamps: both points must be returned.\n    let dup_ts = reference[997].ts;\n    assert_eq!(reference[996].ts, dup_ts); // delta was 0 at i=997\n    let dup_points = reference_filter(&reference, dup_ts, dup_ts);\n    assert!(dup_points.len() >= 2);\n\n    // ---- index pruning actually limits block reads ----------------------\n    let start = reference[2500].ts;\n    let end = reference[2503].ts;\n    let (_, body) = get(addr, &format!(\"/series/ref/range?start={start}&end={end}\"));\n    let scanned = json_u64(&body, \"blocks_scanned\");\n    assert!(scanned <= 2, \"tight window scanned {scanned} blocks\");\n\n    // ---- compression ratio ---------------------------------------------\n    let (_, body) = get(addr, \"/series/ref/stats\");\n    let disk = json_u64(&body, \"disk_bytes\");\n    let uncompressed = json_u64(&body, \"uncompressed_bytes\");\n    assert_eq!(uncompressed, n as u64 * 16);\n    let ratio = json_f64(&body, \"compression_ratio\");\n    assert!(ratio > 2.0, \"expected compressible walk, ratio={ratio} disk={disk}\");\n    // Ratio must equal the honest arithmetic definition.\n    let recomputed = uncompressed as f64 / disk as f64;\n    assert!((ratio - recomputed).abs() < 1e-4);\n\n    // ---- negatives and extreme integers --------------------------------\n    let (st, _) = post(addr, \"/series/extreme?policy=reject\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 201);\n    let extreme = [\n        Point::new(i64::MIN, i64::MIN),\n        Point::new(i64::MIN, i64::MAX),\n        Point::new(i64::MIN + 1, -1),\n        Point::new(-1, i64::MIN),\n        Point::new(0, 0),\n        Point::new(i64::MAX - 1, i64::MAX),\n        Point::new(i64::MAX, i64::MIN),\n    ];\n    let (st, body) = post(addr, \"/series/extreme/points?sync=true\", &body_of(&extreme));\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{body}\");\n    let (_, body) = get(addr, &format!(\"/series/extreme/range?start={}&end={}\", i64::MIN, i64::MAX));\n    assert_eq!(parse_points(&body), extreme);\n\n    // ---- reject policy: whole batch refused, 409 ------------------------\n    let (st, _) = post(addr, \"/series/ord?policy=reject\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 201);\n    let (st, _) = post(addr, \"/series/ord/points\", \"10,1\\n20,2\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    let (st, body) = post(addr, \"/series/ord/points\", \"30,3\\n5,4\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 409, \"out-of-order batch must be rejected: {body}\");\n    let (_, body) = get(addr, \"/series/ord/range?start=0&end=100\");\n    assert_eq!(parse_points(&body), vec![Point::new(10, 1), Point::new(20, 2)]);\n\n    // ---- buffer policy: invisible until drain, then fully merged --------\n    let (st, _) = post(addr, \"/series/late?policy=buffer&block_size=2\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 201);\n    let (st, _) = post(addr, \"/series/late/points\", \"100,1\\n200,2\\n300,3\\n400,4\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200); // two flushed blocks already on disk\n    let (st, body) = post(addr, \"/series/late/points\", \"50,0\\n250,9\\n60,7\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{body}\");\n    assert_eq!(json_u64(&body, \"buffered\"), 3);\n    let (_, body) = get(addr, \"/series/late/buffered\");\n    assert_eq!(json_u64(&body, \"buffered\"), 3);\n    let (_, body) = get(addr, \"/series/late/range?start=0&end=1000\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        parse_points(&body),\n        vec![Point::new(100, 1), Point::new(200, 2), Point::new(300, 3), Point::new(400, 4)]\n    );\n    let (st, body) = post(addr, \"/series/late/drain\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{body}\");\n    assert_eq!(json_u64(&body, \"merged\"), 3);\n    let (_, body) = get(addr, \"/series/late/range?start=0&end=1000\");\n    assert_eq!(\n        parse_points(&body),\n        vec![\n            Point::new(50, 0),\n            Point::new(60, 7),\n            Point::new(100, 1),\n            Point::new(200, 2),\n            Point::new(250, 9),\n            Point::new(300, 3),\n            Point::new(400, 4),\n        ]\n    );\n\n    // ---- injected ENOSPC over HTTP is surfaced, retry succeeds ----------\n    let (st, _) = post(addr, \"/series/victim?policy=reject&block_size=10\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 201);\n    let (st, body) = post(addr, \"/dev/fault\", \"write_limit=30\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{body}\");\n    let pts: Vec<Point> = (0..10).map(|i| Point::new(1000 + i * 5, i)).collect();\n    let (st, body) = post(addr, \"/series/victim/points\", &body_of(&pts));\n    assert_eq!(st, 500, \"ENOSPC must surface as 500: {body}\");\n    assert!(body.contains(\"os error 28\") || body.contains(\"No space\"), \"{body}\");\n    let (st, _) = post(addr, \"/dev/fault\", \"clear\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200);\n    // The failed block is still in the active set; flush retries it.\n    let (st, body) = post(addr, \"/series/victim/flush\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 200, \"{body}\");\n    assert_eq!(json_u64(&body, \"blocks_flushed\"), 1);\n\n    handle.shutdown();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn bad_inputs_are_rejected_cleanly() {\n    let dir = tempdir(\"bad\");\n    let handle = server::serve(\"127.0.0.1:0\", dir, 100, FaultMode::Off).unwrap();\n    let addr = handle.addr();\n\n    let (st, _) = post(addr, \"/series/ok?policy=reject\", \"\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 201);\n    // non-numeric body\n    let (st, _) = post(addr, \"/series/ok/points\", \"not-a-point\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 400);\n    // out-of-i64 integer\n    let (st, _) = post(addr, \"/series/ok/points\", \"9223372036854775808,1\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 400);\n    // missing range params\n    let (st, _) = get(addr, \"/series/ok/range?start=1\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 400);\n    // inverted range\n    let (st, _) = get(addr, \"/series/ok/range?start=10&end=1\");\n    assert_eq!(st, 400);\n    // unknown series / 404);\n\n    handle.shutdown();\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"53089643-d2d7-4068-b564-fd0b4e6d51ba","session_id":"7340a70f-2c1f-48a0-9a1a-9adde575dea4","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp7/b","sessionId":"7340a70f-2c1f-48a0-9a1a-9adde575dea4","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp7-b","slug":"refactored-marinating-thompson"}

Bit-level I/O primitives.\n//!\n//! Bits are packed MSB-first into bytes. Integer deltas are stored with\n//! unsigned LEB128 varints *at the bit level* (no byte alignment between\n//! fields), which is what makes the tag-per-point encoding below compact:\n//! a 1-bit tag can sit directly next to a varint without padding.\n\n/// Writes individual bits and varints into a byte buffer, MSB-first.\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]\npub struct BitWriter {\n    buf: Vec<u8>,\n    /// Accumulated bits waiting to be flushed, left-aligned in the byte.\n    current: u8,\n    /// Number of valid bits in `current` (0..=7).\n    nbits: u32,\n}\n\nimpl BitWriter {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self::default()\n    }\n\n    pub fn with_capacity(cap: usize) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            buf: Vec::with_capacity(cap),\n            current: 0,\n            nbits: 0,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Append the low `nbits` bits of `value` (0 <= nbits <= 64).\n    /// Bits are emitted most-significant first.\n    pub fn write_bits(&mut self, mut value: u64, mut nbits: u32) {\n        debug_assert!(nbits <= 64);\n        while nbits > 0 {\n            // Space available in the current accumulator byte.\n            let space = 8 - self.nbits;\n            let take = nbits.min(space);\n            // Extract the next `take` high bits of the remaining value.\n            let shift = nbits - take;\n            let part = if shift >= 64 { 0 } else { ((value >> shift) & ((1u64 << take) - 1)) as u8 };\n            self.current |= part << (space - take);\n            self.nbits += take;\n            nbits -= take;\n            // Mask off the bits we consumed, handling shift == 64.\n            value = if nbits == 0 {\n                0\n            } else if shift >= 64 {\n                0\n            } else {\n                value & ((1u64 << nbits) - 1)\n            };\n            if self.nbits == 8 {\n                self.buf.push(self.current);\n                self.current = 0;\n                self.nbits = 0;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Write a single bit.\n    pub fn write_bit(&mut self, bit: bool) {\n        self.write_bits(bit as u64, 1);\n    }\n\n    /// Write `value` as exactly 64 bits.\n    pub fn write_u64(&mut self, value: u64) {\n        self.write_bits(value, 64);\n    }\n\n    /// Unsigned LEB128 at the bit level: 7 payload bits per chunk, high bit\n    /// of each chunk marks \"more chunks follow\".\n    pub fn write_varint_u64(&mut self, mut value: u64) {\n        loop {\n            let chunk = (value & 0x7f) as u8;\n            value >>= 7;\n            let more = value != 0;\n            self.write_bit(more);\n            self.write_bits(chunk as u64, 7);\n            if !more {\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Flush the accumulator, padding the final byte with zero bits.\n    pub fn finish(mut self) -> Vec<u8> {\n        if self.nbits > 0 {\n            self.buf.push(self.current);\n        }\n        self.buf\n    }\n\n    /// Total number of payload bits written so far.\n    pub fn bit_len(&self) -> usize {\n        self.buf.len() * 8 + self.nbits as usize\n    }\n}\n\n/// Reads individual bits and varints from a byte buffer, MSB-first.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct BitReader<'a> {\n    buf: &'a [u8],\n    pos: usize, // byte index\n    nbits: u32, // consumed bits within the current byte (0..=7)\n}\n\n#[derive(Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum ReadError {\n    UnexpectedEof,\n}\n\nimpl std::fmt::Display for ReadError {\n    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {\n        write!(f, \"unexpected end of bit stream\")\n    }\n}\n\nimpl std::error::Error for ReadError {}\n\nimpl<'a> BitReader<'a> {\n    pub fn new(buf: &'a [u8]) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            buf,\n            pos: 0,\n            nbits: 0,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Read a single bit.\n    pub fn read_bit(&mut self) -> Result<bool, ReadError> {\n        if self.pos >= self.buf.len() {\n            return Err(ReadError::UnexpectedEof);\n        }\n        let bit = (self.buf[self.pos] >> (7 - self.nbits)) & 1;\n        self.nbits += 1;\n        if self.nbits == 8 {\n            self.pos += 1;\n            self.nbits = 0;\n        }\n        Ok(bit == 1)\n    }\n\n    /// Read exactly `nbits` bits (0 <= nbits <= 64).\n    pub fn read_bits(&mut self, nbits: u32) -> Result<u64, ReadError> {\n        debug_assert!(nbits <= 64);\n        let mut value: u64 = 0;\n        for _ in 0..nbits {\n            value = (value << 1) | (self.read_bit()? as u64);\n        }\n        Ok(value)\n    }\n\n    /// Read exactly 64 bits.\n    pub fn read_u64(&mut self) -> Result<u64, ReadError> {\n        self.read_bits(64)\n    }\n\n    /// Inverse of via `wrapping_shl`).\n    pub fn read_varint_u64(&mut self) -> Result<u64, ReadError> {\n        let mut result: u64 = 0;\n        let mut shift = 0u32;\n        loop {\n            let more = self.read_bit()?;\n            let chunk = self.read_bits(7)?;\n            if shift >= 64 {\n                // >10 chunks: value cannot fit in u64.\n                return Err(ReadError::UnexpectedEof);\n            }\n            result |= chunk << shift;\n            shift += 7;\n            if !more {\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(result)\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn bit_packing_roundtrip() {\n        let mut w = BitWriter::new();\n        let bits: Vec<(u64, u32)> = Injectable storage I/O layer.\n//!\n//! The storage engine never touches `std::fs` directly. It talks to the two\n//! traits below, so tests can deterministically inject the two failure modes\n//! that matter for durability:\n//!\n//! * **partial/failed writes** (simulated `ENOSPC`): after a configured total\n//!   number of bytes has been written, the tail of a straddling write is\n//!   rejected with `ENOSPC` while its fitting prefix is persisted, leaving a\n//!   torn record on disk;\n//! * **failed `fsync`** (simulated barrier / power failure): the next N sync\n//!   calls return `EIO`.\n//!\n//! All file I/O is positional (`*_at`), so there is no shared cursor per file\n//! and no seek state to corrupt. The production backend ([`RealIo`])\n//! implements the traits with `std::fs` and the Unix `FileExt` pread/pwrite\n//! equivalents.\n\nuse std::fs;\nuse std::io;\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, AtomicUsize, Ordering};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\n\n/// A single open file supporting positional reads/writes and durability calls.\npub trait IoFile: Send {\n    /// Write all of `buf` at absolute byte `offset`.\n    fn write_all_at(&mut self, buf: &[u8], offset: u64) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// Positional read; returns the number of bytes read (0 at EOF).\n    fn read_at(&self, buf: &mut [u8], offset: u64) -> io::Result<usize>;\n    /// Flush file data and metadata to stable storage (`fsync`).\n    fn sync(&mut self) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// Truncate or extend the file to exactly `len` bytes.\n    fn set_len(&mut self, len: u64) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// Current file length in bytes.\n    fn len(&self) -> io::Result<u64>;\n}\n\n/// Opens files and performs namespace operations inside one data directory.\npub trait IoBackend: Send + Sync {\n    /// Exclusive create; fails if the path already exists.\n    fn create_new(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Box<dyn IoFile>>;\n    /// Open an existing file for read + write.\n    fn open_write(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Box<dyn IoFile>>;\n    /// Open an existing file read-only.\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Box<dyn IoFile>>;\n    /// `fsync` a directory (required to persist a rename/create).\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// Atomically rename `from` to `to` within the filesystem.\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()>;\n    /// Read an entire small file.\n    fn read_exact_file(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>>;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Production backend\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[derive(Debug, Default, Clone)]\npub struct RealIo;\n\nimpl RealIo {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        RealIo\n    }\n}\n\nstruct RealFile {\n    f: fs::File,\n}\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nuse std::os::unix::fs::FileExt;\n\n#[cfg(unix)]\nimpl IoFile for RealFile {\n    fn write_all_at(&mut self, buf: &[u8], offset: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.f.write_all_at(buf, offset)\n    }\n    fn read_at(&self, buf: &mut [u8], offset: u64) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.f.read_at(buf, offset)\n    }\n    fn sync(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.f.sync_all()\n    }\n    fn set_len(&mut self, len: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.f.set_len(len)\n    }\n    fn len(&self) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        Ok(self.f.metadata()?.len())\n    }\n}\n\nimpl IoBackend for RealIo {\n    fn create_new(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Box<dyn IoFile>> {\n        let f = fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .create_new(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { f }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_write(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Box<dyn IoFile>> {\n        let f = fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .read(true)\n            .write(true)\n            .open(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { f }))\n    }\n\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Box<dyn IoFile>> {\n        let f = fs::File::open(path)?;\n        Ok(Box::new(RealFile { f }))\n    }\n\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        fs::File::open(path)?.sync_all()\n    }\n\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        fs::rename(from, to)\n    }\n\n    fn read_exact_file(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        fs::read(path)\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Fault-injecting backend\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Raw Linux error numbers so injected failures are indistinguishable from\n/// real kernel errors: `ENOSPC` = 28, `EIO` = 5.\npub const ENOSPC: i32 = 28;\npub const EIO: i32 = 5;\n\n/// Mutable fault configuration shared by every file handed out by a\n/// [`FaultyIo`] backend. Reconfigure the shared `Arc<FaultRules>` at runtime;\n/// that is what the `/dev/fault` HTTP endpoint does.\n#[derive(Debug, Default)]\npub struct FaultRules {\n    /// Cumulative bytes that writes may cover before failing.\n    /// `u64::MAX` means \"no limit\".\n    write_limit: AtomicU64,\n    /// Bytes already charged against the limit.\n    bytes_written: AtomicU64,\n    /// Remaining `sync` calls that fail.\n    fail_sync_remaining: AtomicUsize,\n}\n\nimpl FaultRules {\n    pub fn new() -> Self {\n        Self {\n            write_limit: AtomicU64::new(u64::MAX),\n            bytes_written: AtomicU64::new(0),\n            fail_sync_remaining: AtomicUsize::new(0),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// After `limit` more bytes have been written, writes fail with ENOSPC.\n    /// A write straddling the boundary persists its fitting prefix first.\n    pub fn fail_writes_after(&self, limit: u64) {\n        self.write_limit\n            .store(self.bytes_written.load(Ordering::SeqCst) + limit, Ordering::SeqCst);\n    }\n\n    /// The next `n` `sync` calls fail with EIO.\n    pub fn fail_next_syncs(&self, n: usize) {\n        self.fail_sync_remaining.store(n, Ordering::SeqCst);\n    }\n\n    /// Remove all injected faults (counters for already-spent bytes remain).\n    pub fn clear(&self) {\n        self.write_limit.store(u64::MAX, Ordering::SeqCst);\n        self.fail_sync_remaining.store(0, Ordering::SeqCst);\n    }\n\n    pub fn bytes_written(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.bytes_written.load(Ordering::SeqCst)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Backend that delegates to `inner` but injects failures per `rules`.\npub struct FaultyIo {\n    inner: Arc<dyn IoBackend>,\n    rules: Arc<FaultRules>,\n}\n\nimpl FaultyIo {\n    pub fn new(inner: Arc<dyn IoBackend>, rules: Arc<FaultRules>) -> Self {\n        Self { inner, rules }\n    }\n\n    pub fn rules(&self) -> Arc<FaultRules> {\n        Arc::clone(&self.rules)\n    }\n}\n\nstruct FaultyFile {\n    inner: Box<dyn IoFile>,\n    rules: Arc<FaultRules>,\n}\n\nimpl IoFile for FaultyFile {\n    fn write_all_at(&mut self, buf: &[u8], offset: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let limit = self.rules.write_limit.load(Ordering::SeqCst);\n        let used = self.rules.bytes_written.load(Ordering::SeqCst);\n        let budget = limit.saturating_sub(used);\n        if (buf.len() as u64) <= budget {\n            self.inner.write_all_at(buf, offset)?;\n            self.rules\n                .bytes_written\n                .fetch_add(buf.len() as u64, Ordering::SeqCst);\n            Ok(())\n        } else {\n            // Persist the fitting prefix, charge it, then fail like ENOSPC.\n            let fit = budget as usize;\n            if fit > 0 {\n                self.inner.write_all_at(&buf[..fit], offset)?;\n                self.rules\n                    .bytes_written\n                    .fetch_add(fit as u64, Ordering::SeqCst);\n            }\n            Err(io::Error::from_raw_os_error(ENOSPC))\n        }\n    }\n\n    fn read_at(&self, buf: &mut [u8], offset: u64) -> io::Result<usize> {\n        self.inner.read_at(buf, offset)\n    }\n\n    fn sync(&mut self) -> io::Result<()> {\n        let mut remaining = self.rules.fail_sync_remaining.load(Ordering::SeqCst);\n        while remaining > 0 {\n            match self.rules.fail_sync_remaining.compare_exchange(\n                remaining,\n                remaining - 1,\n                Ordering::SeqCst,\n                Ordering::SeqCst,\n            ) {\n                Ok(_) => return Err(io::Error::from_raw_os_error(EIO)),\n                Err(v) => remaining = v,\n            }\n        }\n        self.inner.sync()\n    }\n\n    fn set_len(&mut self, len: u64) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.set_len(len)\n    }\n\n    fn len(&self) -> io::Result<u64> {\n        self.inner.len()\n    }\n}\n\nimpl IoBackend for FaultyIo {\n    fn create_new(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Box<dyn IoFile>> {\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultyFile {\n            inner: self.inner.create_new(path)?,\n            rules: Arc::clone(&self.rules),\n        }))\n    }\n    fn open_write(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Box<dyn IoFile>> {\n        Ok(Box::new(FaultyFile {\n            inner: self.inner.open_write(path)?,\n            rules: Arc::clone(&self.rules),\n        }))\n    }\n    fn open_read(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Box<dyn IoFile>> {\n        self.inner.open_read(path)\n    }\n    fn sync_dir(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.sync_dir(path)\n    }\n    fn rename(&self, from: &Path, to: &Path) -> io::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.rename(from, to)\n    }\n    fn read_exact_file(&self, path: &Path) -> io::Result<Vec<u8>> {\n        self.inner.read_exact_file(path)\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build a path inside `dir` {"parentUuid":"a043d52e-1add-4e5d-9c08-e470a558a437","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_awutgmduw87poit8largkjar","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp7/b/requests.http.md","content":"# tsblock HTTP 请求样例\n#\n# 所有样例假设服务运行在 127.0.0.1:8080：\n#   ./target/release/tsblock --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --data-dir ./data --block-size 1000 --fault\n#\n# 写入点的请求体是每行一个 `timestamp,value`（均为有符号 i64），空行忽略。\n# 响应均为手工生成的 JSON。完整可运行脚本见 requests.sh。\n\n## 健康检查\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n\n## 列出所有序列\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/series\n\n## 创建序列（policy=reject 默认；block_size 覆盖全局默认）\ncurl -s -X POST \"http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/cpu?policy=reject&block_size=1000\"\n\n## 创建“乱序缓冲”策略的序列\ncurl -s -X POST \"http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/late?policy=buffer\"\n\n## 写入点（值含负数）\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/cpu/points \\\n  --data-binary $'1700000000,-5\\n1700000060,-3\\n1700000120,-4\\n1700000180,-1'\n\n## 写入并在响应前强制落盘（flush + fsync）\ncurl -s -X POST \"http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/cpu/points?sync=true\" \\\n  --data-binary $'1700000240,2\\n1700000300,5'\n\n## 边界查询（闭区间 [start,end]）；时间和值都允许 i64 极值\ncurl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/cpu/range?start=1700000060&end=1700000240\"\ncurl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/cpu/range?start=-9223372036854775808&end=9223372036854775807\"\n\n## 压缩统计（真实压缩比 = 未压缩 16B/点 ÷ 实际磁盘字节）\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/cpu/stats\n\n## 手动把活动块 fsync 成一个数据块\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/cpu/flush\n\n## 乱序点（reject 策略 -> 整批拒绝，HTTP 409，已有点不变）\ncurl -s -w \"\\nHTTP %{http_code}\\n\" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/cpu/points \\\n  --data-binary $'1700000360,9\\n100,0'\n\n## buffer 策略：迟到点进入侧缓冲，查询不可见\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/late/points --data-binary $'100,1\\n200,2\\n300,3'\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/late/points --data-binary $'150,9\\n50,0'\ncurl -s http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/late/buffered\ncurl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/late/range?start=-9223372036854775808&end=9223372036854775807\"\n\n## drain：压缩重写，把侧缓冲并入历史（原子 rename + 目录 fsync）\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/late/drain\ncurl -s \"http://127.0.0.1:8080/series/late/range?start=-9223372036854775808&end=9223372036854775807\"\n\n## 故障注入（仅 --fault 启动时可用）\n# 再写入 N 字节后让写操作返回 ENOSPC（跨界写只落前半段 -> 产生尾部残记录）\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/dev/fault --data-binary $'write_limit=64'\n# 让下一次 fsync 返回 EIO\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/dev/fault --data-binary $'fail_syncs=1'\n# 清除全部注入故障\ncurl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/dev/fault --data-binary $'clear'\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_5f556f4eca7363cd8fa62f15","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":858,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":110392,"output_tokens":1499,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_awutgmduw87poit8largkjar":{"content":"# {"parentUuid":"40ef3384-faec-4c83-a6a0-138987d18090","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ydxjiz4arhi5to2zracbgutn","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp7/b/README.md","content":"# tsblock — 时间序列块编码（纯后端）\n\n零第三方依赖（只用 Rust `std`）的文件型整数时间序列存储，外加一个本地\nHTTP 验证入口。时间戳与值均为有符号 `i64`。\n\n* 时间戳：**delta-of-delta（DOD）** 变长编码\n* 值：**一阶差分（first difference）** + zigzag 变长编码\n* 每点 1 bit 标签选择“紧凑差分”或“64 bit 原值逃逸”，溢出语义明确\n* 块索引按时间范围做区间裁剪，查询只读重叠块\n* 乱序点：整批拒绝（默认）或进入独立侧缓冲（查询不可见），显式 `drain` 压缩重写合并\n* 存储 I/O 走可注入接口层，可模拟 **ENOSPC 部分写**与 **fsync 返回 EIO**\n* 每条记录 CRC-32 校验；重开时尾部残记录被检出并截断\n\n## 构建 / 测试\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\ncargo test                 # 32 个测试：单元 + 故障注入 + HTTP 端到端验收\ncargo clippy --all-targets # 0 warning\n```\n\n无外部 crate，可离线构建（Rust 1.98 验证通过）。\n\n## 运行\n\n```bash\n./target/release/tsblock --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --data-dir ./data --block-size 1000 [--fault]\n```\n\n* `--addr` 默认 `127.0.0.1:0`（内核分配临时端口，启动日志打印实际端口）\n* `--fault` 开启 `/dev/fault` 故障注入端点\n* 请求样例：[`requests.http.md`](requests.http.md)（curl 清单）、\n  [`requests.sh`](requests.sh)（自启动服务并跑完整个流程的可执行脚本）\n\n## 磁盘格式\n\n一个序列 = 数据目录下一个 `<name>.tsb` 文件。序列名白名单\n（`[A-Za-z0-9_.-]`，不得以 `.`/`-` 开头），直接映射文件名且拒绝路径穿越。\n\n```text\n文件头（20 字节）\n  0..4   magic   = b\"TSBK\"\n  4..6   version = u16 LE = 1\n  6..8   flags   = u16 LE；bit0 = 乱序策略（0 reject / 1 buffer）\n  8..12  block_size = u32 LE\n  12..20 reserved（8 个 0）\n\n其后为顺序追加的记录\n  payload_len : u32 LE\n  crc32       : u32 LE   CRC-32/ISO-HDLC，仅对 payload 计算\n  payload     : payload_len 字节（块编码，见下）\n```\n\n块索引**不单独持久化**：打开文件时逐条记录顺序扫描重建\n（偏移、payload 长度、首末时间戳、点数）。扫描遇到短头、长度越界、CRC\n不符或解码失败即判定为尾部残记录（崩溃 / ENOSPC 中途写的典型痕迹），\n在该处截断并 `fsync`，此前所有完整记录保留。\n\n### 块 payload（位流，MSB-first）\n\n```text\ncount      : u32 LE（4 字节，字节对齐）\nfirst_ts   : 64 bit\nfirst_value: 64 bit\n之后每个点：\n  时间戳标签 0 : zigzag-varint\n                 · 常规状态 = 与上一个时间差的 delta-of-delta\n                 · 逃逸后首点 = 与上一点的原始 delta\n  时间戳标签 1 : 64 bit 原始时间戳，并重置 DOD 预测器（溢出逃逸）\n  值标签   0 : zigzag-varint 的一阶差分\n  值标签   1 : 64 bit 原始值（溢出逃逸）\n```\n\nzigzag 后的无符号数用**位级** unsigned LEB128（每块 1 bit 续位 + 7 bit\n载荷），因此标签和 varint 之间没有字节填充。\n\n### 溢出语义（明确边界）\n\n所有预测器运算用 `i128`。当 DOD（或重置后的原始 delta、或值差分）\n不能放进 `i64` 时，编码器写标签 1 + 64 bit 原值并重置对应预测器；\n解码器用同样的 `i128` 重建，任何越界结果报错。特别地，运行中的时间差\n本身以 `i128` 保存——即使原始 delta 超过 `i64`，DOD 仍可能很小\n（例：时间戳 `i64::MIN, -1, i64::MAX`，DOD = 1）。因此任意合法\n`i64` 点序列都能无损往返；`i64::MIN`/`i64::MAX` 是合法端点。\n\n## 同步边界（durability）\n\n* 块记录 = **写完整条记录 + `fsync` 成功**后才进入内存索引、才算已持久化。\n  二者任一失败：错误返回给客户端，点保留在活动块可重试，索引不更新；\n  磁盘上可能出现的残记录由下次打开时 CRC 检出截断。\n* 创建序列：写文件头 → 文件 `fsync` → 目录 `fsync`（保证目录项持久）。\n* `drain` 压缩重写：写临时文件 `.name.compact.tmp` 并 `fsync` →\n  原子 `rename` 覆盖 → 目录 `fsync`。失败则原文件不动。\n* 活动块与侧缓冲仅在内存中：进程崩溃即丢失；缓冲点在 `drain` 成功前不持久。\n\n## 乱序语义\n\n迟到 = `ts <` 序列高水位（**相等时间戳是合法重复点，不拒绝**）。\n\n* `reject`（默认）：写入前整批校验，批次自身必须时间非递减，且不得低于\n  高水位；违规则整批拒绝（HTTP 409），不接受任何一个点。\n* `buffer`：迟到点进独立侧缓冲，不推进高水位，对所有查询不可见；\n  同批中的有序点照常接收。`POST /series/{n}/drain` 读出全部已落盘块 +\n  活动块 + 侧缓冲，按时间戳**稳定排序**（历史点在并列时优先），重编码为\n  block_size 块并原子重写整个文件。\n\n## HTTP 接口\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| GET | `/health` | 存活检查 |\n| GET | `/series` | 序列列表 |\n| POST | `/series/{name}?policy=reject\\|buffer&block_size=N` | 创建序列 |\n| GET | `/series/{name}/stats` | 块数、磁盘字节、真实压缩比 |\n| POST | `/series/{name}/points?sync=true` | 追加，body 每行 `ts,value` |\n| GET | `/series/{name}/range?start=&end=` | 闭区间查询 |\n| POST | `/series/{name}/flush` | 活动块落盘（写+fsync） |\n| POST | `/series/{name}/drain` | 侧缓冲压缩重写合并 |\n| GET | `/series/{name}/buffered` | 侧缓冲点数 |\n| POST | `/dev/fault` | 仅 `--fault`：`write_limit=<字节>` / `fail_syncs=<n>` / `clear` |\n\n查询响应含 `blocks_scanned`（为本次查询实际从磁盘读取并 CRC 校验的块数），\n`bytes_read`，可直接观察索引区间裁剪效果。压缩比定义为\n`(已落盘点 + 活动块点) × 16 ÷ 实际磁盘记录字节`，stats 实时给出。\n\n## 实测结果（如实记录）\n\n命令：`cargo build --release && bash requests.sh`（数据：10000 点，时间戳\n间隔 58–64 秒并每 1000 点一次重复时间戳，值为 ±3 随机游走；block_size=1000）\n\n```\n写入：{\"accepted\":10000,\"buffered\":0,\"blocks_flushed\":10}\n统计：disk_bytes=22763  uncompressed_bytes=160000  compression_ratio=7.02895\n首点边界查询：blocks_scanned=1\n全域查询：  count=10000 blocks_scanned=10\n乱序写入：  HTTP 409 out-of-order point ts=1 is older than last accepted ts=9999999999\nbuffer：   2 个迟到点缓冲 → drain merged=2, blocks_rewritten=11\nENOSPC：   write_limit 后写入 → HTTP 500 \"os error 28\"；clear 后 flush 成功\n重启：     10 个块全部恢复，数据一致\n```\n\n说明：7.03x 是这组“近等间隔 + 小幅游走”数据的实测值，不是格式承诺；\n随机/剧烈跳变数据压缩比会接近 1（每点走 64 tsblock — 时间序列块编码（纯后端）\n\n零第三方依赖（只用 Rust `std`）的文件型整数时间序列存储，外加一个本地\nHTTP 验证入口。时间戳与值均为有符号 `i64`。\n\n* 时间戳：**delta-of-delta（DOD）** 变长编码\n* 值：**一阶差分（first difference）** + zigzag 变长编码\n* 每点 1 bit 标签选择“紧凑差分”或“64 bit 原值逃逸”，溢出语义明确\n* 块索引按时间范围做区间裁剪，查询只读重叠块\n* 乱序点：整批拒绝（默认）或进入独立侧缓冲（查询不可见），显式 `drain` 压缩重写合并\n* 存储 I/O 走可注入接口层，可模拟 **ENOSPC 部分写**与 **fsync 返回 EIO**\n* 每条记录 CRC-32 校验；重开时尾部残记录被检出并截断\n\n## 构建 / 测试\n\n```bash\ncargo build --release\ncargo test                 # 32 个测试：单元 + 故障注入 + HTTP 端到端验收\ncargo clippy --all-targets # 0 warning\n```\n\n无外部 crate，可离线构建（Rust 1.98 验证通过）。\n\n## 运行\n\n```bash\n./target/release/tsblock --addr 127.0.0.1:8080 --data-dir ./data --block-size 1000 [--fault]\n```\n\n* `--addr` 默认 `127.0.0.1:0`（内核分配临时端口，启动日志打印实际端口）\n* `--fault` 开启 `/dev/fault` 故障注入端点\n* 请求样例：[`requests.http.md`](requests.http.md)（curl 清单）、\n  [`requests.sh`](requests.sh)（自启动服务并跑完整个流程的可执行脚本）\n\n## 磁盘格式\n\n一个序列 = 数据目录下一个 `<name>.tsb` 文件。序列名白名单\n（`[A-Za-z0-9_.-]`，不得以 `.`/`-` 开头），直接映射文件名且拒绝路径穿越。\n\n```text\n文件头（20 字节）\n  0..4   magic   = b\"TSBK\"\n  4..6   version = u16 LE = 1\n  6..8   flags   = u16 LE；bit0 = 乱序策略（0 reject / 1 buffer）\n  8..12  block_size = u32 LE\n  12..20 reserved（8 个 0）\n\n其后为顺序追加的记录\n  payload_len : u32 LE\n  crc32       : u32 LE   CRC-32/ISO-HDLC，仅对 payload 计算\n  payload     : payload_len 字节（块编码，见下）\n```\n\n块索引**不单独持久化**：打开文件时逐条记录顺序扫描重建\n（偏移、payload 长度、首末时间戳、点数）。扫描遇到短头、长度越界、CRC\n不符或解码失败即判定为尾部残记录（崩溃 / ENOSPC 中途写的典型痕迹），\n在该处截断并 `fsync`，此前所有完整记录保留。\n\n### 块 payload（位流，MSB-first）\n\n```text\ncount      : u32 LE（4 字节，字节对齐）\nfirst_ts   : 64 bit\nfirst_value: 64 bit\n之后每个点：\n  时间戳标签 0 : zigzag-varint\n                 · 常规状态 = 与上一个时间差的 delta-of-delta\n                 · 逃逸后首点 = 与上一点的原始 delta\n  时间戳标签 1 : 64 bit 原始时间戳，并重置 DOD 预测器（溢出逃逸）\n  值标签   0 : zigzag-varint 的一阶差分\n  值标签   1 : 64 bit 原始值（溢出逃逸）\n```\n\nzigzag 后的无符号数用**位级** unsigned LEB128（每块 1 bit 续位 + 7 bit\n载荷），因此标签和 varint 之间没有字节填充。\n\n### 溢出语义（明确边界）\n\n所有预测器运算用 `i128`。当 DOD（或重置后的原始 delta、或值差分）\n不能放进 `i64` 时，编码器写标签 1 + 64 bit 原值并重置对应预测器；\n解码器用同样的 `i128` 重建，任何越界结果报错。特别地，运行中的时间差\n本身以 `i128` 保存——即使原始 delta 超过 `i64`，DOD 仍可能很小\n（例：时间戳 `i64::MIN, -1, i64::MAX`，DOD = 1）。因此任意合法\n`i64` 点序列都能无损往返；`i64::MIN`/`i64::MAX` 是合法端点。\n\n## 同步边界（durability）\n\n* 块记录 = **写完整条记录 + `fsync` 成功**后才进入内存索引、才算已持久化。\n  二者任一失败：错误返回给客户端，点保留在活动块可重试，索引不更新；\n  磁盘上可能出现的残记录由下次打开时 CRC 检出截断。\n* 创建序列：写文件头 → 文件 `fsync` → 目录 `fsync`（保证目录项持久）。\n* `drain` 压缩重写：写临时文件 `.name.compact.tmp` 并 `fsync` →\n  原子 `rename` 覆盖 → 目录 `fsync`。失败则原文件不动。\n* 活动块与侧缓冲仅在内存中：进程崩溃即丢失；缓冲点在 `drain` 成功前不持久。\n\n## 乱序语义\n\n迟到 = `ts <` 序列高水位（**相等时间戳是合法重复点，不拒绝**）。\n\n* `reject`（默认）：写入前整批校验，批次自身必须时间非递减，且不得低于\n  高水位；违规则整批拒绝（HTTP 409），不接受任何一个点。\n* `buffer`：迟到点进独立侧缓冲，不推进高水位，对所有查询不可见；\n  同批中的有序点照常接收。`POST /series/{n}/drain` 读出全部已落盘块 +\n  活动块 + 侧缓冲，按时间戳**稳定排序**（历史点在并列时优先），重编码为\n  block_size 块并原子重写整个文件。\n\n## HTTP 接口\n\n| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| GET | `/health` | 存活检查 |\n| GET | `/series` | 序列列表 |\n| POST | `/series/{name}?policy=reject\\|buffer&block_size=N` | 创建序列 |\n| GET | `/series/{name}/stats` | 块数、磁盘字节、真实压缩比 |\n| POST | `/series/{name}/points?sync=true` | 追加，body 每行 `ts,value` |\n| GET | `/series/{name}/range?start=&end=` | 闭区间查询 |\n| POST | `/series/{name}/flush` | 活动块落盘（写+fsync） |\n| POST | `/series/{name}/drain` | 侧缓冲压缩重写合并 |\n| GET | `/series/{name}/buffered` | 侧缓冲点数 |\n| POST | `/dev/fault` | 仅 `--fault`：`write_limit=<字节>` / `fail_syncs=<n>` / `clear` |\n\n查询响应含 `blocks_scanned`（为本次查询实际从磁盘读取并 CRC 校验的块数），\n`bytes_read`，可直接观察索引区间裁剪效果。压缩比定义为\n`(已落盘点 + 活动块点) × 16 ÷ 实际磁盘记录字节`，stats 实时给出。\n\n## 实测结果（如实记录）\n\n命令：`cargo build --release && bash requests.sh`（数据：10000 点，时间戳\n间隔 58–64 秒并每 1000 点一次重复时间戳，值为 ±3 随机游走；block_size=1000）\n\n```\n写入：{\"accepted\":10000,\"buffered\":0,\"blocks_flushed\":10}\n统计：disk_bytes=22763  uncompressed_bytes=160000  compression_ratio=7.02895\n首点边界查询：blocks_scanned=1\n全域查询：  count=10000 blocks_scanned=10\n乱序写入：  HTTP 409 out-of-order point ts=1 is older than last accepted ts=9999999999\nbuffer：   2 个迟到点缓冲 → drain merged=2, blocks_rewritten=11\nENOSPC：   write_limit 后写入 → HTTP 500 \"os error 28\"；clear 后 flush 成功\n重启：     10 个块全部恢复，数据一致\n```\n\n说明：7.03x 是这组“近等间隔 + 小幅游走”数据的实测值，不是格式承诺；\n随机/剧烈跳变数据压缩比会接近 1（每点走 64 bit 逃逸）。未压缩基准统一为\n`i64 ts + i64 value = 16 字节/点`。\n\n边界 / 负值 / 重复时间戳 / `i64` 极值由自动化测试核验（对照朴素未压缩数组\n逐项 `retain` 过滤）：\n\n```\ncargo test\n# 26 个库内单元测试（位打包、varint、CRC 向量、编解码、溢出逃逸、\n#   拒绝/缓冲语义、drain 压缩重写、索引裁剪……）\n#  4 个故障注入集成测试（ENOSPC 部分写、人造残记录截断、fsync EIO、极值往返）\n#  2 个 HTTP 端到端测试（5000 点对照参考数组的 8 组边界窗口、\n#   压缩比一致性、409、缓冲/drain、故障重试、各类 400/404）\n```\n\n### 已知限制（非目标）\n\n* 无前端；HTTP/1.1 为每连接单请求、无 keep-alive，仅供本地验证。\n* 单写者锁（`Mutex`）；查询会读取活动块快照，面向功能验证而非吞吐基准。\n* 块索引仅在内存；超大文件重开需顺序扫描全部记录头。\n* 缓冲点仅在内存，drain 前不持久。\n* `blocks_scanned`（为本次查询实际从磁盘读取并 CRC 校验的块数），\n`bytes_read`，可直接观察索引区间裁剪效果。压缩比定义为\n`(已落盘点 + 活动块点) × 16 ÷ 实际磁盘记录字节`，stats 实时给出。\n\n## 实测结果（如实记录）\n\n命令：`cargo build --release && bash requests.sh`（数据：10000 点，时间戳\n间隔 58–64 秒并每 1000 点一次重复时间戳，值为 ±3 随机游走；block_size=1000）\n\n```\n写入：{\"accepted\":10000,\"buffered\":0,\"blocks_flushed\":10}\n统计：disk_bytes=22763  uncompressed_bytes=160000  compression_ratio=7.02895\n首点边界查询：blocks_scanned=1\n全域查询：  count=10000 blocks_scanned=10\n乱序写入：  HTTP 409 out-of-order point ts=1 is older than last accepted ts=9999999999\nbuffer：   2 个迟到点缓冲 → drain merged=2, blocks_rewritten=11\nENOSPC：   write_limit 后写入 → HTTP 500 \"os error 28\"；clear 后 flush 成功\n重启：     10 个块全部恢复，数据一致\n```\n\n说明：7.03x 是这组“近等间隔 + 小幅游走”数据的实测值，不是格式承诺；\n随机/剧烈跳变数据压缩比会接近 1（每点走 64 bit 逃逸）。未压缩基准统一为\n`i64 ts + i64 value = 16 字节/点`。\n\n边界 / 负值 / 重复时间戳 / `i64` 极值由自动化测试核验（对照朴素未压缩数组\n逐项 `retain` 过滤）：\n\n```\ncargo test\n# 26 个库内单元测试（位打包、varint、CRC 向量、编解码、溢出逃逸、\n#   拒绝/缓冲语义、drain Injectable storage I/O layer.\n2\t//!\n3\t//! The storage engine never touches `std::fs` directly. It talks to the two\n4\t//! traits below, so tests can deterministically inject the two failure modes\n5\t//! that matter for durability:\n6\t//!\n7\t//! * **partial/failed writes** (simulated `ENOSPC`): after a configured total\n8\t//!   number of bytes has been written, the tail of a straddling write is\n9\t//!   rejected with `ENOSPC` while its fitting prefix is persisted, leaving a\n10\t//!   torn record on disk;\n11\t//! * **failed `fsync`** (simulated barrier / power failure): the next N sync\n12\t//!   calls return `EIO`.\n13\t//!\n14\t//! All file I/O is positional (`*_at`), so there is no shared cursor per file\n15\t//! and no seek state to corrupt. 交付内容（`/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp7/b`）\n\n**源码（Rust，零第三方依赖，纯 std，约 3300 行）**\n- `src/bitio.rs` — MSB-first 位缓冲 + 位级 unsigned LEB128（标签与 varint 间无字节填充）\n- `src/coding.rs` — 块编码：时间戳 delta-of-delta、值一阶差分、zigzag；**i128 运算 + 1-bit 标签的 64-bit 原值逃逸**，溢出语义明确（含\"原始 delta 超 i64 但 DOD 很小\"的边界）\n- `src/crc.rs` — CRC-32/ISO-HDLC（含标准校验向量）\n- `src/io_layer.rs` — `IoFile`/`IoBackend` 可注入接口；`RealIo`（pread/pwrite）与 `FaultyIo`（ENOSPC 跨界部分写、fsync EIO）\n- `src/store.rs` — 磁盘格式、重开时重建的内存块索引（二分区间裁剪）、同步边界、乱序 reject/buffer 两种语义、drain 全量压缩原子重写\n- `src/server.rs` — 手写 HTTP/1.1 本地验证入口（含 `/dev/fault`）\n- `src/main.rs` — CLI\n\n**文档与样例**：`README.md`（磁盘格式图、同步边界、溢出/乱序语义、实测记录、已知限制）、`requests.http.md`（curl 清单）、`requests.sh`（自启动跑完整个流程）\n\n**测试**：32 个全过——26 单元 + 4 故障注入 + 2 HTTP 端到端；`cargo clippy --all-targets` 零警告。\n\n## 验收要点（已实际运行并如实记录）\n\n- **对照参考未压缩数组**：5000 点随机数据，8 组边界窗口（精确端点、单点、空窗、跨块、负值、i64 全域）逐一与朴素 `retain` 过滤结果一致\n- **负值 / 重复时间 / 最大整数**：测试覆盖 `i64::MIN`、`i64::MAX`、重复 ts、极值间跳跃的逃逸编码\n- **区间读取**：紧窗口实测 `blocks_scanned ≤ 2`（10 块中），响应回显实际读块数与字节数\n- **真实压缩比**：10000 点实测 22763 B / 160000 B = **7.03x**（近等间隔小幅游走数据；README 明确说明这是实测值非承诺，剧烈跳变会趋近 1）\n- **乱序**：reject 整批 409 且不留点；buffer 缓冲期查询不可见，drain 压缩重写后并入（含早于首个已落盘块的点）\n- **故障注入**：ENOSPC 部分写 → HTTP 500 `os error 28`，点保留可重试；fsync EIO → 错误上报；人造残记录重开时 CRC 检出并截断，`torn_records=1`，已同步数据无损\n\n**未通过项：无。** 唯一限制是设计内取舍（README \"已知限制\" 已列出）：无前端、无 keep-alive、索引仅内存、缓冲点 drain 前不持久、重复时间戳不去重。未做 git 提交（未要求）。","type":"text"}],"id":"msg_59e2a56cec1298121aa4b9aa","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"end_turn","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1031,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":121656,"output_tokens":857,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"apiBlockIndex":1,"type":"assistant","uuid":"40dc256b-6f0f-4402-bf42-17d7296d71f7","timestamp":"2026-09-23T02:12:26.139Z","effort":"high","perTurnEffort":null,"session_id":"7340a70f-2c1f-48a0-9a1a-9adde575dea4","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp7/b","sessionId":"7340a70f-2c1f-48a0-9a1a-9adde575dea4","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp7-b","slug":"refactored-marinating-thompson"}
